userStories.title: Add BTC macro kill switch to run_range_pipeline.py
userStories.description:
Current state: run_range_pipeline.py at businesses/horizen-zkverify/range-trader/scripts/run_range_pipeline.py has no BTC macro check. In a crypto crash, all support levels break simultaneously.

What to build:
1. Add get_btc_4h_change() function (same as base-trader's fix):
   - Call CoinGecko free API: GET https://api.coingecko.com/api/v3/coins/bitcoin/market_chart?vs_currency=usd&days=1
   - Extract price from ~4h ago and current
   - Return % change (negative if dropped)
   - On error: return 0.0 (neutral)
   - 10-second timeout

2. In main(), after scan but before filtering:
   - btc_change = get_btc_4h_change()
   - If btc_change < -3.0:
     - Print '[PIPELINE] BTC macro kill switch: {btc_change:.1f}% in 4h — skipping BUY signals'
     - Filter out all BUY signals (keep SELL signals — selling during a crash is correct)
     - Log the kill switch activation in run_log

3. SELL signals must NOT be blocked by the kill switch — if a stop loss triggers during a crash, we absolutely want to sell.

Constraints:
- Do NOT modify range_scanner.py, range_signal_filter.py, or range_execute.py
- The -3% threshold should be a constant at module level: BTC_KILL_SWITCH_PCT = -3.0
- CoinGecko free tier: no API key needed, 10-30 calls/min
userStories.notes:
Implemented BTC macro kill switch in run_range_pipeline.py:
- Added get_btc_4h_change() function that calls CoinGecko API to get BTC price change over last 4 hours
- Added BTC_KILL_SWITCH_PCT = -3.0 c
